summaries.pregnancy-status-opposition: The supplied reports contain opposing pregnancy-status information. Endo cannot determine which report is correct.
summaries.pregnancy-status-review: Pregnancy-status information differs between the supplied reports. Clinician review is needed to understand the discrepancy.

questions.check-effective-dates: Do the reports refer to the same effective date or point in time?
questions.check-correction-status: Has either report been corrected or superseded?
questions.verify-reported-status: Can the original reporting source verify the pregnancy-status information?
